insert into [dbo].[tbl_calypso_amendment_datesAvailable2]
 select cast(substring(Business_Date,19,2) + '/' + substring(Business_Date,21,2) + '/' + substring(Business_Date,23,4) as date) as Business_Date
 from [dbo].[tbl_calypso_amendment_datesAvailable]

insert into tbl_calypso_amendment_datesLoaded
   select distinct substring(FileFolder_Source,19,2) + '/' + substring(FileFolder_Source,21,2) + '/' + substring(FileFolder_Source,23,4) as Business_Date
 FROM [OtcTradeAuditing].[dbo].[tbl_Trade_Amend_Audit]

insert into tbl_calypso_amendment_datesLoaded2
   select distinct cast(Business_Date as date) as Busines_Date
 FROM [dbo].[tbl_calypso_amendment_datesLoaded]

insert into [dbo].[tbl_calypso_amendment_datesToLoad]
SELECT        TOP (100) PERCENT dbo.tbl_calypso_amendment_datesAvailable2.Business_Date, 'PnLByTradeDetails_' + REPLACE(CONVERT(varchar, dbo.tbl_calypso_amendment_datesAvailable2.Business_Date, 101), '/', '') 
                         + '.csv' AS MissingFileName
FROM            dbo.tbl_calypso_amendment_datesAvailable2 LEFT OUTER JOIN
                         dbo.tbl_calypso_amendment_datesLoaded2 ON dbo.tbl_calypso_amendment_datesAvailable2.Business_Date = dbo.tbl_calypso_amendment_datesLoaded2.Business_Date
WHERE        (dbo.tbl_calypso_amendment_datesLoaded2.Business_Date IS NULL) AND (dbo.tbl_calypso_amendment_datesAvailable2.Business_Date > CONVERT(DATETIME, '2021-02-24 00:00:00', 102))
ORDER BY dbo.tbl_calypso_amendment_datesAvailable2.Business_Date

update [dbo].[tbl_Trade_Amend_Audit]
set [Business_Datetime] = cast(substring(Business_Date,0,len(Business_Date)-6) as date)
where cast(substring(business_date,0,len(Business_Date)-6) as date) >= '1/1/2022'
and Business_Datetime is null

UPDATE [dbo].[tbl_Trade_Amend_Audit] 
SET [dbo].[tbl_Trade_Amend_Audit].GaapRelief_Exist = 'Y'
FROM
(SELECT distinct [Business_Date], Calypso_reference 
  FROM [OtcTradeAuditing].[dbo].[tbl_Trade_Amend_Audit] nolock
  WHERE Gaap_Relief_Mapping = 'Q'
  and Business_Date_Rpt  >= '1/1/2022'
  )  A
 JOIN [dbo].[tbl_Trade_Amend_Audit] B
 ON A.[Business_Date] = B.[Business_Date]
 AND A.[Calypso_Reference] = B.[Calypso_Reference]
 WHERE B.Gaap_Relief_Mapping = 'Q'
 and b.Business_Date_Rpt  >= '1/1/2022'

UPDATE [dbo].[tbl_Trade_Amend_Audit]
SET EconomicChange_Exist = 'Y'
FROM 
(SELECT distinct [Business_Date], [Calypso_Reference]    
  FROM [dbo].[tbl_Trade_Amend_Audit]
  WHERE [dbo].[tbl_Trade_Amend_Audit].[Economic_Change] = 'Economic'
  and Business_Date_Rpt  >= '1/1/2022'
 ) A
 JOIN [dbo].[tbl_Trade_Amend_Audit] B
 ON A.[Business_Date] = B.[Business_Date]
 AND A.[Calypso_Reference] = B.[Calypso_Reference]
 WHERE B.Economic_Change IS NOT NULL
 and b.Business_Date_Rpt  >= '1/1/2022'

UPDATE dbo.tbl_Trade_Amend_Audit
SET       TrueAmendment = 'Amendment'
FROM   (SELECT Calypso_Reference, modif_date
             FROM    (SELECT Business_Date_Rpt, Calypso_Reference, Book_Name, Product_Type, MAX(User_Name) AS User_Nme, Trade_Status, MAX(Business_Date) AS modif_date, CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART([year], Business_Date_Rpt)) + CONVERT(varchar(2), 
                                         (CASE WHEN DATEPART(month, [Business_Date_Rpt]) < 10 THEN '0' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(month, [Business_Date_Rpt])) ELSE CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(month, [Business_Date_Rpt])) END)) + '01', 126) AS Business_Month, 
                                         COUNT(Action_Status) AS ttl_Action, SUM(CASE WHEN [Action_status] = 'DONE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Done_Status, SUM(CASE WHEN [Action_status] = 'REJECT_AMEND' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Rejected_Status, 
                                         SUM(CASE WHEN [Action_status] NOT IN ('DONE', 'REJECT_AMEND') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Track_Status, CASE WHEN (SUM(CASE WHEN [Action_status] = 'DONE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - (SUM(CASE WHEN [Action_status] NOT IN ('DONE', 'REJECT_AMEND') 
                                         THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN [Action_status] = 'REJECT_AMEND' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))) = 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE (CASE WHEN (SUM(CASE WHEN [Action_status] = 'DONE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) = 0 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END) END AS Trade_Included
                           FROM    dbo.tbl_Trade_Amend_Audit AS tbl_Trade_Amend_Audit_1
                           WHERE  (Action_Status IN ('STARTAMEND_SALES', 'START_AMEND', 'DONE', 'REJECT_AMEND')) AND (Before IN ('DAY_PEND_AMEND', 'DAY_SALES_AMEND', 'PENDING_AMEND', 'SALES_PEND_AMEND', 'DAY_MO_REVIEW', 'DAY_VERIFIED', 'VERIFIED')) AND 
                                         (After IN ('DAY_MO_REVIEW', 'DAY_VERIFIED', 'VERIFIED', 'DAY_PEND_AMEND', 'DAY_SALES_AMEND', 'PENDING_AMEND', 'SALES_PEND_AMEND')) AND (YEAR(Business_Date_Rpt) > 2015) AND (Field_Amended = '_status')
                           GROUP BY Business_Date_Rpt, Calypso_Reference, Book_Name, Product_Type, Trade_Status) AS Amend_Detail
             WHERE  ((CASE WHEN ([Trade_Included] = 'N') THEN 0 ELSE (CASE WHEN ([Track_status] > 0) THEN Track_Status - Rejected_Status ELSE Done_Status END) END) > 0)) AS B INNER JOIN
             dbo.tbl_Trade_Amend_Audit ON B.Calypso_Reference = dbo.tbl_Trade_Amend_Audit.Calypso_Reference AND B.modif_date = dbo.tbl_Trade_Amend_Audit.Business_Date
